name: Hero Carousel — displays valid motorcycle model names and active indicator
description: Verifies that the Hero turntable carousel accurately renders the active motorcycle model name and provides selector tabs for all models.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and inspect the Hero section
The active motorcycle headline element displays an authentic model name such as 'CLASSIC 350', 'BULLET 350', 'HUNTER 350', 'METEOR 350', 'HIMALAYAN 450', or 'CLASSIC 350 SIGNALS'
The bottom carousel pill dock displays navigation buttons for all Royal Enfield motorcycles
The active model button contains a highlighted gold indicator pill and active gradient styling
Click the model navigation button for 'HUNTER 350'
The active motorcycle headline updates to display 'HUNTER 350'
